```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The current Administration's refusal to work with Republicans increased the national debt from $10 trillion to nearly $19 trillion today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"If left unchecked, the national debt will reach $30 trillion by 2026.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration's policies systematically crippled economic growth and job creation, increasing government costs and decreasing revenues.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"When Congressional Republicans tried to reverse course, the Administration manufactured fiscal crises and government shutdowns to demand excessive spending.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration's demands focused on significantly expanding government spending and benefits for its preferred groups, funded by loans that future generations will have to repay.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"This path of spending will bankrupt the next generation.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for a constitutional requirement for a federal balanced budget.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for Congress to adopt and the states to ratify a Balanced Budget Amendment which limits spending to the appropriate historical average percentage of the nation's gross domestic product.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for a Balanced Budget Amendment requiring a super-majority for any tax increase, with exceptions only for war or legitimate emergencies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Only a constitutional safeguard such as a Balanced Budget Amendment can prevent deficits from mounting to government default.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
